microkernel_architecture.architecture: ARM64e (AArch64 with Pointer Authentication PAC00 & BTI)

privilege_levels.EL1: sepOS microkernel executive (kernel core, scheduler, memory manager, trap handlers)
privilege_levels.EL0: sepOS isolated system services and cryptographic server conclaves

hard_realtime_classes: Biometric sensor frame capture (Pearl Face ID NIR strobe synchronization)
ASCwrap-v6 Mailbox outbox FIFO drain handlers
soft_realtime_classes: AppleKeyStore class key derivation and caching

sub_partitions.name: sep_boot_window
sub_partitions.role: Decrypted sepOS microkernel text, read-only data, exception vectors, and early translation tables.

sub_partitions.name: sep_kernel_heap
sub_partitions.role: Zone allocator for Thread Control Blocks (TCBs), task descriptors, port right hashes, and IPC queues.

sub_partitions.name: sep_user_task_pools
sub_partitions.role: Isolated userland service memory spaces (KeyStoreServer, BiometricServer, ApplePayServer).

sub_partitions.name: sep_crypto_staging
sub_partitions.role: AES-XTS encrypted buffers for key unwrapping, class key caching, and ephemeral key generation.

sub_partitions.name: pearl_sensor_frame_buffer
sub_partitions.role: Raw Near-Infrared (NIR) flood/dot sensor frames streamed directly from camera ISP via isp_map_iobmd.

sub_partitions.name: ane_feature_staging_buffer
sub_partitions.role: Biometric neural embedding and feature tensor verification buffer shared with ANE via ane_map_iobmd.

sub_partitions.name: exclave_secure_bridge_window
sub_partitions.role: Direct memory channel to ExclaveOS conclaves mediated by DART-SEP Stream ID 2 (mapper-sep-exclave).

features: Zero-leakage physical registers for intermediate AES and PKA keys
Hardware-enforced instant zeroization upon core reset, sleep, or tamper detection
